cards.ex: Even though she's new to the team, she's definitely in contention for a starting spot.
cards.exUz: U jamoaga yangi kelgan bo'lsa ham, u aniq boshlang'ich o'rin uchun da'vogar.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun kurashayotgan, imkoniyati bor bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: He managed to edge out his opponent in the final round.
cards.exUz: U so'nggi raundda raqibidan ustun kela oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik farq bilan g'alaba qozonmoq, raqibdan ozgina o'tib ketmoq.

cards.ex: Her performance really raised the bar for everyone else on the team.
cards.exUz: Uning ishlashi jamoaning qolgan a'zolari uchun talabni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Standartni yoki kutishlarni yuqoriroq darajaga ko'tarmoq.

cards.ex: The team is enjoying a winning streak and is hoping to keep it going.
cards.exUz: Jamoa g'alabalar seriyasidan rohatlanmoqda va uni davom ettirishga umid qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ketma-ket g'alabalarning davomiyligi, bir nechta o'yinda yutish.

cards.ex: There's always stiff competition for places on the national team.
cards.exUz: Milliy terma jamoada o'rinlar uchun doimo qattiq raqobat bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va qiyin raqobatchilar mavjudligi.

cards.ex: We started the season behind the eight ball due to injuries.
cards.exUz: Jarohatlar tufayli mavsumni qiyin ahvolda boshladik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: He got a head start by training during the off-season.
cards.exUz: U mavsumdan tashqari mashq qilib, imtiyozga ega bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinroq boshlash va ustunlikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He wasn't considered a frontrunner, but he turned out to be a dark horse.
cards.exUz: U yetakchi deb hisoblanmagan, ammo kutilmagan g'olib bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonishi kutilmagan, ammo muvaffaqiyatga erisha oladigan shaxs.

cards.ex: If you play your cards right, you could win the championship.
cards.exUz: Agar to'g'ri harakat qilsangiz, chempionatda g'alaba qozonishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri qarorlar qabul qilib, muvaffaqiyatga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The underdog team pulled off a major upset by defeating the champions.
cards.exUz: Oddiy jamoa chempionlarni mag'lub etib, katta sensatsiya yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va hayratlanarli natija, ayniqsa raqib mag'lub bo'lganda.

cards.ex: She started slowly, but then she pulled ahead in the second half of the race.
cards.exUz: U sekin boshladi, lekin keyin poyganing ikkinchi yarmida oldinga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra tezroq oldinga siljish, raqibdan o'tib ketish.

cards.ex: The game was a real nail-biter, going into overtime.
cards.exUz: O'yin juda hayajonli bo'ldi, qo'shimcha vaqtga o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda hayajonli va keskin, natijasi oxirigacha noma'lum bo'lgan o'yin.

cards.ex: Our team dominated the game from start to finish.
cards.exUz: Bizning jamoa o'yinni boshidan oxirigacha ustunlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'yinda to'liq nazoratni qo'lga kiritish va ustunlikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He has the stamina to go the distance in a marathon.
cards.exUz: U marafon davomida oxirigacha kurashish uchun chidamlilikka ega.
cards.uzDef: Oxirigacha chidash, qiyinchiliklarga qaramay maqsadga erishish.

cards.ex: Everyone loves a good underdog story, especially in sports.
cards.exUz: Hamma yaxshi oddiy g'alabasini yaxshi ko'radi, ayniqsa sportda.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsizning muvaffaqiyatga erishishi haqidagi hikoya.

cards.ex: He showed great sportsmanship, congratulating his opponent after the loss.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib sport odobini ko'rsatdi, mag'lubiyatdan keyin raqibini tabrikladi.
cards.uzDef: Sportda adolatli o'yin, hurmat va yaxshi xulq-atvor qoidalari.

cards.ex: They have a significant home-field advantage due to their passionate fans.
cards.exUz: Ularning ashaddiy muxlislari tufayli uy maydonida sezilarli afzalliklarga ega.
cards.uzDef: O'z maydonida o'ynashning afzalligi, muxlislar qo'llab-quvvatlashi.

cards.ex: Fair play is essential for maintaining the integrity of the sport.
cards.exUz: Sportning halolligini saqlash uchun halol o'yin muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga rioya qilish va adolatli o'ynash.

cards.ex: It was a close contest, with both teams fighting hard until the very end.
cards.exUz: Bu keskin bahs edi, ikkala jamoa ham oxirigacha qattiq kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noma'lum va raqobat juda kuchli bo'lgan o'yin.

cards.ex: Everyone is looking forward to the rematch between the two rivals.
cards.exUz: Hamma ikki raqib o'rtasidagi qasos uchrashuvini kutmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi uchrashuvdagi mag'lubiyatdan keyin yana bir bor uchrashish.

cards.ex: The boxer was on the ropes after taking several heavy blows.
cards.exUz: Bokschi bir nechta og'ir zarbalardan keyin qiyin ahvolda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiyin ahvolda, mag'lubiyatga yaqin holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The team achieved a clean sweep, winning all their matches.
cards.exUz: Jamoa barcha o'yinlarda g'alaba qozonib, to'liq g'alabaga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha o'yinlarda yoki musobaqalarda g'alaba qozonish.

cards.ex: It was such a close race, it ended in a photo finish.
cards.exUz: Poyga shunchalik yaqin ediki, foto finish bilan yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: G'olibni aniqlash uchun fotodan foydalanilgan juda yaqin finish.

cards.ex: The sports commentator gave an insightful analysis of the game.
cards.exUz: Sport sharhlovchisi o'yin haqida chuqur tahlil berdi.
cards.uzDef: Sport tadbirlarini kuzatib boradigan va ularni tahlil qiladigan shaxs.

cards.ex: Even though they lost, they went out swinging and gave it their all.
cards.exUz: Mag'lub bo'lishsada, ular kurashib mag'lub bo'lishdi va bor kuchlarini berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oxirigacha kurashmoq, taslim bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The negotiations were tough; both sides were playing hardball.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar qiyin edi; ikkala tomon ham qattiq kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijaga erishish uchun qattiq va murosasiz harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The coach had to take the heat after the team's poor performance.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy jamoaning yomon ishlashidan keyin tanqidni qabul qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid yoki aybni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: Against all odds, he won the race.
cards.exUz: Qarshilikka qaramay, u poygada g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatga qaramay, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: The loss was a bitter defeat for the team after such a strong season.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kuchli mavsumdan keyin mag'lubiyat jamoa uchun achchiq mag'lubiyat bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda achinarli va hafsalasini pir qiladigan mag'lubiyat.

cards.ex: She's considered the front runner in the upcoming election.
cards.exUz: U yaqinlashib kelayotgan saylovda yetakchi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish uchun eng yaxshi imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan shaxs.
